data_anim_effects:
Animation bank $0E: the shared effect animations (file offsets 458752-460526, SNES $0E:8000-$86EE, bank 07; 1775 bytes).

=== MODEL ===
Same format as bank $0A. 17 lists (animation ids $00-$10), 83 steps and 28 frame leaves for the effects shared by many scenes: animation 00 and 02 the appear puffs (RunMonsterAppearPuff, RunAppearPuff), 03 the death puff (RunEnemyDeath), $10 the puff that replaces a hazard (RunHazardPuff). Actors select it with COP A8 #$8000, #$0E (RunAppearPuff and the other effect scripts) or through 4 meta entries (+8..+A = this bank).
data_anim_magic:
Animation bank $0F: the animations of the hero's spells and the Phoenix shots (file offsets 491520-500833, SNES $0F:8000-$A461, bank 07; 9314 bytes).

=== MODEL ===
Same format as bank $0A. 54 lists (ids $00-$35), 264 steps and 124 frame leaves. Only 8 scripts select it, each with COP A8 #$8000, #$0F: seven in player_spells_level_up (the spell actors and their children) and the shared start of the four Phoenix shot scripts in player_core. The Flame Pillar, for example, plays animation $1C, then $1B twenty times and $1D (OQ-I014-8 asks for the total time). The graphics of the equipped spell are swapped into VRAM by LoadEquippedMagicGfx (MagicGraphicsPointers).
